name: Takasaki Akiho
source:
Likes: The hero (her husband), Sweets, Fashion
Dislikes: Bitter Things
Hobbies: To Study, Competitions (although she doesn´t like to gamble)
Virtues: Sincere and Cheerful
Defects: Recklessness

She is a lively bride and a patisserie apprentice who always do her best because she hates to lose. although she loves her husband she sees him as her greatest rival.
